thread:
Maya Patel: Quick intake — can we queue Raptor-11B for onboarding? link: https://models.internal/raptor-11b. Requesting prioritization: customer X asked for lower-cost variant and we should evaluate 8-bit/4-bit quant.
Samir Rao: +1. What's the target workloads? embeddings, chat, or long-form?
Maya Patel: Primary: chat/generation with ~1k token contexts. Secondary: embeddings for semantic search (low qps).
Olivia Chen: I'll own quality evals. Can we get a reference eval set (sensitive prompts, code, summarization, retrieval)?
Maya Patel: Uploading eval sets to /datasets/raptor_intake this afternoon.
Kai Morgan: I can run quantization experiments. Proposal: fp16 baseline -> ptq int8 -> awq/llm.int8() -> nf4 4-bit. Rough timeline: baseline perf by EOD Thu, int8 experiments Fri.
Jordan Lee: I'll handle catalog entry + docs. Need model card fields: license, tokenizer, max_seq_len, known regressions. Anyone have license?
Maya Patel: License: Apache-2.0 (from vendor). Tokenizer: byte-level BPE, vocab 50288. Max seq 2048.
Samir Rao: For infra: suggest dedicated nightly bench job for latency/p99 across batch sizes 1,4,8. Add GPU types: A10G, H100. I can add runners.
Olivia Chen: Quick note: include targeted regression probes (toxicity, code correctness, factuality). We'll compare against Lumen-13B and Nova-7B baselines.
eval-bot: Benchmark run queued: raptor-11b baseline fp16 on A10G (job id: bench-183900). Estimated runtime 45m.
Kai Morgan: Command I'll use for PTQ:
```bash
python quantize.py --model raptor-11b --method awq --bits 8 --calib_samples 128
```
I'll post logs in the thread.
Samir Rao: For rollout policy: canary on Dedicated -> routing fallback to hosted smaller model if latency SLO breaches. Also opt-in region staging.
Jordan Lee: Drafting catalog entry: short_name: raptor-11b, family: raptor, size: 11B, tags: [chat, embeddings, quant-friendly]. Will push PR to infra-catalog repo when baseline numbers in.
Maya Patel: Announcement plan: internal announcement to eng and support after quant pass. Public blog + changelog if quality OK. Who drafts the release note?
Olivia Chen: I can draft quality summary + eval graphs. Samir can supply perf numbers. Jordan will add doc links.
Kai Morgan: FYI early numbers: fp16 perplexity on eval set 15.2, int8 AWQ -> 15.6. Latency p50/p99 on A10G batch1: 82ms / 210ms (fp16). Will update with H100.
Samir Rao: Good. If p99 > 300ms on batch1 we punt to canary with traffic cap.
Maya Patel: Owners: Maya (product), Olivia (eval), Kai (quant), Samir (infra), Jordan (docs/catalog). I'll create a GH issue with checklist.
Jordan Lee: Can we add a short announce blurb for support: "Raptor-11B is now available in the catalog; recommended for chat workloads; use quant profiles for cost savings. Contact eng-ml@redwood for issues."
Maya Patel: Perfect. Next sync Tuesday 10am to review final numbers and approve public announcement. @everyone please drop blockers here. :thumbsup:
Olivia Chen: blocker: need a small dev budget for extra H100 hours. Samir — can you allocate?
Samir Rao: I'll request quota increase, ping infra-finance.
Kai Morgan: I'll push the quant artifact to s3://redwood-quant/raptor-11b/awq-8bit and attach MD5.
eval-bot: bench-183900 completed: fp16 latency numbers posted to /benchmarks/raptor-11b/bench-183900.csv
Maya Patel: Thanks all — filing the intake issue now and adding the owners + timeline.
